harness: probe service (tools/stallfloor/probe.py): frozen kernel families, every thread of every launch judged against a host-computed checksum
what: a set of producers under TWO predicates on ONE write barrier (kind ord with pguard), the chain of an attention kernel: eight `@P0 LDG.E.128` / `@P0 LDG.E.U8` pairs + `@P2 LDG.E` (17 producers), its 9-suffix, `@P0 LDG.E.U8` + `@P2 LDG.E`, and a 5-set with two `@P2 LDG.E`; P0 written again between the pairs by ISETP.GE.AND with the SAME value; each predicate true | false | a bit of the lane (on the set of one `@P0 LDG.E.U8` also a bit of the iteration counter); warm and cold lines; ONE wait of the reader 2 cycles behind the last arming; each layout in which a producer executes with its positive control (the reader's wait bit moved behind the reader's instructions)

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

provenance.dep_table_commit: ff2a2c1 tools/stallfloor/README: the class of the first result of probe_sm120_20261112_b50.json

classes.good: the intended values in all 256 iterations
classes.stale: raw / ord: the consumer took the register's previous content in all 256
classes.late: war: the store took the rewritten register in all 256
classes.overtake: war: the read-back saw the slot before the store in all 256
